title: fix(console): stop MetadataDetailPage re-fetch loop that flaked CI
body:
- [x] Investigate CI failure on run 25541629421 (job 74968605319)
- [x] Identify root cause: `useMetadataService()` / `useMetadata()` mocks returned fresh object literals every render → `MetadataDetailPage`'s `fetchItem` `useCallback` reference changed every render → data-fetch `useEffect` re-fired in an infinite `setLoading(true)` → re-render → re-fetch loop. Locally the resolved promise won the race; in CI under load the page was sometimes still in `loading=true` when assertions ran. Same loop also produced the `act(...)` warnings.
- [x] Stabilize the test mocks (`apps/console/dev/__tests__/MetadataDetailPage.test.tsx`) by hoisting `mockMetadataService` and `mockMetadataContext` to module-level singletons.
- [x] Harden the source (`apps/console/src/legacy/MetadataDetailPage.tsx`) so the same loop can no longer be triggered by an unstable hook caller in any host: read `metadataService` and `config.label` through `useRef`s, drop them from `fetchItem` / `handleSave` `useCallback` deps.
- [x] Verify locally: 5 consecutive runs of the affected test file → 11/11 pass each time, no act warnings.
- [x] Run full repo test suite (`pnpm test`) → 393 passed | 1 skipped (394) test files, 6358 passed | 29 skipped (6387) tests, 0 failures.
- [x] Update `CHANGELOG.md` under `Unreleased > Fixed`.
- [x] Run `parallel_validation` (Code Review + CodeQL) — CodeQL skipped as trivial.
- [x] Merge latest `origin/main` (c2b8ef3c — `[4.0.2]` release + changeset) and resolve the `CHANGELOG.md` conflict by keeping our new `Unreleased > Fixed` entry on top of the promoted `[4.0.2]` section.
- [x] Re-verify the previously failing test still passes after the merge (11/11).
